fields.label: Stunts · original proposals
fields.value: Margin Reader: +2 Investigate to create an advantage identifying alterations in a physical document. Hear the Missing Beat: +2 Notice to create an advantage identifying disrupted timing after listening to one complete machine cycle. Keeper's Courtesy: +2 Rapport to overcome a public archivist's reluctance to grant supervised access to nonrestricted records.

fields.label: Durability / refresh
fields.value: Physical [1][2][3]; mental [1][2][3]. Mark at most one box per hit; consequences may also absorb harm. Empty shared consequence slots: mild 2, moderate 4, severe 6. Refresh 3; three free stunts.

fields.label: Play now
fields.value: Find who forged tomorrow's collection roll without letting the hospital's borrowed-time reserve run dry. The Nera connection is a proposed backstory link; agree other PCs' phase connections together.
